snippet.title: Dverghold Early Access release date revealed!
snippet.description:
Dverghold launches in Early Access on July 22, 2026! 

Our first-person grid-based dungeon crawler in the tradition of Dungeon Master and Eye of the Beholder, with tactical turn-based combat that plays more like an FPS than a menu - positioning, environment, and timing all matter. Build up your basecamp between expeditions, recruit a roster of mercenaries and descend into the haunted depths of Rekestt. Features an original dungeon synth soundtrack by Splendorius and Kurald Galain.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216280/Dverghold/

#Dverghold #IndieGame #DungeonCrawler #CRPG #RPG
